costumes.name: Masquerade Swan
costumes.description:
Quency: Escape Queen costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text:
Hey, Instructor, how do I look in this outfit? 
You don't think it's too small?

I think being a thief suits me.
Maybe I should just consider a career switch?

Don't call me a thief.
For today, and today only, I'm on the side of justice.

Which outfit do you prefer?
I bet this one caught your fancy, right?

If I'm doing my thief thing,
you and I can hang out all day? Nice!

Since I'm gonna be visiting often, I need to dig a few more tunnels leading to your room, Instructor.
That's okay with you, right?

Instructor, if you leave your post for too long,
who knows where I, with some choice objects in tow, might run off to?

You must be busy. Fine, take your time.
I'll consider which route to work on today.

If Sin and Guilty come looking for me, tell them you haven't seen me.
I can't run into them wearing this outfit.

I'm looking for routes that thieves can use.
Do you want to find some together?

Have you seen Phantom and Miranda? 
We were supposed to meet here.

I'm Quency the Thief.
Shall I plan another grand escape today in the name of justice?
Thanks to you, Instructor, I feel nimbler!
Thank you. I'll try become a thief for justice.
What if I become too strong and famous? That wouldn't necessarily be ideal for a thief, haha.
What's this? Is it a new mask?
All I can really give you in return are some bottle caps...

Oooh, just what I needed!
Thank you, Instructor. I'll put it to good use!
Is it okay if I dig a path to your heart, Instructor?
You're quite the thief yourself, stealing my heart, hehe.

I think you may be too smitten with me, Instructor.
Then again, I'm quite taken by you too!
Can I put on the mask before I head out?
The route is ready!
I know a shortcut, wanna see?
Commencing thief activities!
Let us go forward in the name of justice!
Pick up any bottle caps you can!
There's so much to do!
Reloading.
I've got to scout for some new routes as well.
What should I steal this time?
I'm ready!
I'll snatch it in the blink of an eye!
I'll take that.
Too easy.
I stole everything!
Next route!
Eek!
Ouch!
Huh!
What if this disrupts the schedule of the Phantom Thieves?
Anything else I can do to help the thieves?
Thanks to the Thieves of Justice, I even get the chance to attend a masquerade ball.
There are so many things here worth swiping! Oh, don't worry. I'm working with the good guys today.
All these masks make everyone look like Thieves of Justice, haha.
How do I look, Instructor? Do I resemble a graceful swan?
I practiced really hard for you, Instructor. So you're not allowed to look at other girls, got it?
Care to dance with me, Instructor? No one will recognize us anyway.
It feels a bit lonely attending a ball without a partner.
Maybe I'll practice some dance moves while I wait for my partner to show up.
If I nab something quickly while I'm dancing, I'm sure no one will notice, right? Hehe.
One, two, three. One, two, three.
This place is so spacious and quiet. Perfect for dancing.
It is I, Quency, the Phantom Swan. Allow me to perform a graceful number for you!
Now I can make even more elegant escapes!
I could dance all day!
My body feels so light... like I've become a real swan!
This is the perfect gift to wrap up the ball! Thank you!
I'm in such a great mood! Shall we dance?
As a thank you, allow me to show you my beautiful swan dance.
Even with a mask on, your good looks still shine through, Instructor.
I can't help but be greedy! So stay right by my side, Instructor.
You're not trying to run, are you, Instructor? Guess I'll have to block all the escape routes.
Is it time for me to take the stage?
Did you call?
Lightly on my feet!
There are way too many people who want to dance with me.
Let's dance!
Let's dance our hearts out.
Boom-ba! Doom-ba!
One moment. My feet hurt.
I'm starting to feel tired.
Is there anything worth stealing?
Hold my hand!
I'll borrow you for the ball for just a moment!
Let's all dance together!
Next!
Come back when you've had more practice!
We've emptied out everything!
Eeep!
Agh!
So this is how the ball comes to an end...
Nothing is more fun than dancing with you, Instructor.
